message: We should also love each other and stay connected to each other
reply: 📖 1 John 4:7 Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. Amen! 🙏
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD have His will done! 🕊️ Amen! 🙏
